<a id="page-list"></a>

## About this page

How the list of items is laid out, what each row shows, and what a click on a row does.

#### How it works

**Layout** sets the shape of the list and its order. **Rows** decides what each row carries. **Clicks** decides what a click and a double-click on a row do.

The **Sort and layout** button above the list changes the same layout, grouping and sort settings, so you can switch without coming here.

#### On Android

**Layout** sets the shape of the list and its order. **Rows** decides what each row carries. **Gestures** decides what a tap and a swipe do.

**Above the list** chooses the cards or rows at the top of the vault, before your items.

See also [Item list](/guide/screens/#screen-list), [Sidebar](/guide/settings/navigation/), [Item page](/guide/settings/entry/).

<a id="setting-layout"></a>

## Layout

The shape of the list: full rows, shorter rows, or a grid of tiles.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| List | Full rows, with the second line under the name if that is on. |
| Compact | Smaller icons and no second line, so more rows fit. |
| Grid | Large tiles with the name under each. Pinned items, headings and folded sites are not used. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

See also [Second line](/guide/settings/list/#setting-row-subtitle), [Grouping](/guide/settings/list/#setting-grouping), [Row height](/guide/settings/look/#setting-density).

<a id="setting-grouping"></a>

## Grouping

Whether the list runs as one, with logins for the same site folded together, or splits into one part for each folder.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| By site | One list in the order you sort by. Several logins for one website fold into a single row when [Fold logins on one site](/guide/settings/list/#setting-group-sites) is on. |
| By folder | A part for each folder, in alphabetical order, and **No folder** for items in none. Each part follows the sort order. Sites are not folded. |

See also [Section headings](/guide/settings/list/#setting-list-headings), [Sort by](/guide/settings/list/#setting-sort), [Folders](/guide/settings/folders/).

<a id="setting-sort"></a>

## Sort by

The order of items in the list.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Name | A to Z by name. |
| Last changed | The item you changed most recently comes first. |
| Type | By type, such as Cards before Logins, then by name. |
| Website | By website, then by name. Items with no website come last. |

See also [Grouping](/guide/settings/list/#setting-grouping), [Pinned items first](/guide/settings/list/#setting-pinned-on-top).

<a id="setting-pinned-on-top"></a>

## Pinned items first

Keeps the items you have pinned above everything else in the list.

#### How it works

Choose **Pin to the top** for an item to pin it, and **Unpin** to let it go back.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| On | Pinned items come first, under a **Pinned** heading if headings are on. |
| Off | Pinned items take their normal place. They stay pinned, and move back up when you turn this on again. |

See also [Section headings](/guide/settings/list/#setting-list-headings), [Sort by](/guide/settings/list/#setting-sort).

<a id="setting-group-sites"></a>

## Fold logins on one site

Shows several logins for the same website as one row, which opens to show each account.

#### How it works

The row shows the site and how many accounts it holds. Open it to see them, and again to fold them away.

#### When to use it

Useful when you keep more than one account on a site, such as a personal one and one for work.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

Only logins fold, and only while the list is grouped by site.

See also [Grouping](/guide/settings/list/#setting-grouping).

<a id="setting-list-headings"></a>

## Section headings

Shows a heading above each part of the list: **Pinned** and **All items** when you have pinned items, or each folder's name when the list is grouped by folder.

See also [Grouping](/guide/settings/list/#setting-grouping), [Pinned items first](/guide/settings/list/#setting-pinned-on-top).

<a id="setting-filter-chips"></a>

## Filter chips

*Only in Android.*

A row of chips above the list that narrows it to one kind of item: All, Favorites, and one for each type you have.

#### How it works

Favorites appears once you have starred something. The types are listed with the one you have most of first.

<a id="setting-search-at-bottom"></a>

## Search at the bottom

*Only in Android.*

Moves the vault's search bar from the top of the screen to the bottom, above the navigation bar, within reach of your thumb.

#### Limits

Only in the Standard [style](/guide/settings/look/#setting-ui-style). Glass keeps search in the round button at the foot of the screen.

See also [Left-handed](/guide/settings/navigation/#setting-left-handed).

<a id="setting-row-icons"></a>

## Icons

Shows each item's icon at the start of its row: the site's mark, a letter, or the symbol for its type.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

The grid layout always shows icons.

See also [Site icons](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-site-icon-style), [Shape](/guide/settings/icons/#setting-site-icon-shape).

<a id="setting-row-subtitle"></a>

## Second line

Shows the username or another detail under each item's name.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

The compact layout leaves it out to save room.

See also [Layout](/guide/settings/list/#setting-layout).

<a id="setting-row-badges"></a>

## Small marks

Small symbols beside an item's name: a star for a favorite, and marks for a one-time code, a passkey and an attachment.

#### How it works

A red timer means the item is set to delete itself. Its page says when.

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

<a id="setting-row-button"></a>

## Button on the row

A copy button at the end of each row, shown while the pointer is over it.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Copy password | Copies the item's password. Items without one have no button. |
| Copy username | Copies the username of a login or a database. |
| Copy code | Copies the current one-time code. Only items with a code have the button. |
| None | Rows have no button. Right-click a row for the same choices. |

*The guide in the app shows this live, with your own settings.*

#### Limits

A copied password or code is cleared after the time under [Clear the clipboard after](/guide/settings/security/#setting-clipboard-seconds). A username stays until you copy something else.

#### On Android

On the phone it is called Button on the right.

A copy button at the right end of each row.

When [Tap](/guide/settings/list/#setting-tap-action) is set to copy something, this button becomes an arrow that opens the item instead.

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Copy password | Copies the item's password. Items without one have no button. |
| Copy username | Copies the username of a login or a database. |
| Copy code | Copies the current one-time code. Only items with a code have the button. |
| None | Rows have no button. |

See also [Click](/guide/settings/list/#setting-tap-action), [Clear the clipboard after](/guide/settings/security/#setting-clipboard-seconds).

<a id="setting-tap-action"></a>

## Click

What a single click on a row does.

#### How it works

An item with nothing to copy, such as a note, only opens.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Open | Opens the item. |
| Copy password | Copies the password and opens the item. |
| Copy username | Copies the username and opens the item. |
| Copy code | Copies the current one-time code and opens the item. |

#### On Android

On the phone it is called Tap.

What a tap on a row does.

An item with nothing to copy, such as a note, opens instead.

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Open | Opens the item. |
| Copy password | Copies the password without opening the item. The button on the right becomes an arrow that opens it. |
| Copy username | Copies the username without opening the item. The button on the right becomes an arrow that opens it. |
| Copy code | Copies the current one-time code without opening the item. The button on the right becomes an arrow that opens it. |

See also [Double-click](/guide/settings/list/#setting-double-click), [Button on the row](/guide/settings/list/#setting-row-button).

<a id="setting-double-click"></a>

## Double-click

*Only in the desktop app and the browser extension.*

What a double-click on a row or a tile does.

#### How it works

A double-click starts with a click, so whatever **Click** is set to happens first.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Copy password | Copies the password. |
| Copy username | Copies the username. |
| Edit | Opens the item in the editor. |
| Open site | Opens the item's website in your browser. |
| Nothing | A double-click does no more than a click. |

See also [Click](/guide/settings/list/#setting-tap-action).

<a id="setting-swipe-right"></a>

## Swipe right

*Only in Android.*

What sliding a row to the right does.

#### How it works

An item without what the swipe needs, such as a code, is left as it is.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Copy password | Copies the password. |
| Copy username | Copies the username of a login or a database. |
| Copy code | Copies the current one-time code. |
| Favorite | Adds the item to your favorites, or takes it out. |
| Nothing | A swipe to the right does nothing. |

See also [Swipe left](/guide/settings/list/#setting-swipe-left), [Click](/guide/settings/list/#setting-tap-action).

<a id="setting-swipe-left"></a>

## Swipe left

*Only in Android.*

What sliding a row to the left does.

#### What each choice does

| Choice | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| Move to trash | Moves the item to the trash. A message lets you undo it. |
| Favorite | Adds the item to your favorites, or takes it out. |
| Copy password | Copies the password. |
| Nothing | A swipe to the left does nothing. |

See also [Swipe right](/guide/settings/list/#setting-swipe-right), [Trash](/guide/settings/trash/).

<a id="setting-widgets"></a>

## Above the list

*Only in Android.*

What the vault shows at the top, before your items. Add the ones you want and put them in order.

#### How it works

- *Favorites* shows your starred items as a row of tiles.
- *Recently changed* shows the ten items you changed last.
- *Health* says how many passwords need attention. Tap it to open Health.
- *Codes* is a shortcut to your one-time codes.

Drag a row by its handle to move it. The bin removes it, and its **Add** row brings it back.

#### Limits

In the Standard style, Health shows only when something needs attention.

See also [Health screen](/guide/screens/#screen-health), [Codes screen](/guide/screens/#screen-codes).
